settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Your profile, churches, appearance and availability.

calendar.title: Calendar sync
calendar.description: Subscribe to your schedule in Google, Apple, or Outlook Calendar. Rotating the link revokes the previous one.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Keep leaders informed: add the dates you can’t serve below, or confirm nothing has changed.

preferences.title: Scheduling preferences
preferences.description: How often and when you’d like to serve. Schedulers see these as warnings, not rules.

organization.emptyDescription: Create and switch between every church you administer.

access.title: Access
access.description: Give leaders exactly the areas they run. Team leaders are set on the Teams page; library and directory permissions are church-wide.
access.explainTitle: Why can (or can’t) someone do something?

denial.not_a_member: Not a member of this church.
denial.scoped_scheduler_without_grant: A scoped scheduler with no grant for this.
denial.grant_outside_scope: They have this permission, but for a different service type or team.
denial.no_matching_grant: No role or grant gives this permission.

rosters.title: Team rosters
rosters.restrict: Members see only their own teams’ rosters
rosters.restrictHint: Plus teams a team’s leaders open up to them. Leaders and schedulers still see every roster.

across.title: Across my churches
across.description_one: You belong to {{count}} church. These options are off unless you turn them on.
across.description_other: You belong to {{count}} churches. These options are off unless you turn them on.
across.combinedSchedule: Show my schedules from every church together (only I see this)
across.shareBusy: Warn schedulers in my other churches when I’m busy (they see only “busy”, no details)
across.copyTitle: Copy blockout dates to another church
across.copyEmpty: Add a one-off blockout above first.
across.includeReason: Include my reasons (their schedulers can read them)

affected.unchangedCanDecline_one: Saving won’t change its answer; decline it if you can no longer do it.
affected.unchangedCanDecline_other: Saving won’t change their answers; decline any you can no longer do.

review.neverReviewed: Leaders can’t tell yet whether these dates are current.
review.affirmTheirs: Their availability is up to date
review.affirmMine: My availability is up to date
review.requestTitle: A leader asked you to review your availability
review.requestHint: Add blockout dates below, or confirm your availability is up to date.

blockouts.title: Blockout dates
blockouts.description: Times you can’t serve, interpreted in {{timezone}}. Existing assignments are never declined automatically.
blockouts.descriptionTheirs: Times they can’t serve, interpreted in {{timezone}}. Existing assignments are never declined automatically.
blockouts.ambiguous: If the clock repeats this time
blockouts.clockHint: Times skipped when the clock moves forward are rejected. Monthly dates missing from a month are skipped.
blockouts.seriesHint: Manage individual, future, or all occurrences on the series page.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: What happened to schedule emails, pushes and in-app notifications. “Accepted by provider” means the email or push service took the message; it does not confirm the person saw it.
delivery.noWorker: No scheduled delivery worker is configured, so retries and anything interrupted wait until someone acts again or an operator runs the worker.

error.recipient_not_eligible: No longer scheduled or no longer a member
error.scheduler_not_active: Scheduler is no longer active in this church
error.request_missing: The availability request no longer exists
error.provider_timeout: Provider did not answer in time
error.outcome_unknown: Interrupted while sending; it may have been sent
error.worker_lease_expired: Worker stopped before sending; will retry
error.reminder_obsolete: Reminder no longer applied when it was about to be sent
error.provider_duplicate_key: Provider already has an earlier attempt of this message; it may have been sent
error.content_removed: The comment or message was removed before it was sent

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Group service types by campus or ministry. Permissions on a folder apply to everything inside it.
folders.moveTitle: This move changes who has access

identity.title: Possible duplicate people
identity.description: We never combine people just because their details match. Decide here whether two records are the same person.
identity.mergeHint: Merging moves {{candidate}}’s requests and history to {{person}}.

integrations.title: Developer API and webhooks
integrations.description: Let an approved integration read published plans and songs, and tell it when plans are published.
integrations.secretOnce: Copy it now and store it somewhere safe. It will not be shown again.
integrations.revokeKeyConfirm: Revoke “{{name}}”? Integrations using it stop working on their next request.
integrations.revokeEndpointConfirm: Revoke this endpoint? It receives nothing further; its delivery history is kept.
integrations.keyHint: Read-only. Keys see published plans, service types and the song library — never people, notes, files or drafts. A key stops working if it is revoked, expires, or you stop being an administrator.
integrations.noDeliveries: Nothing has been sent to this endpoint yet.
integrations.endpointHint: Events carry only ids; the receiver reads details with an API key. Requests are signed (Standard Webhooks) and retried with the same event id, so receivers should verify the signature and ignore ids they have seen.
integrations.webhooksUnavailable: Webhooks are not available: the server has no secret-encryption key configured.
integrations.noWorker: No scheduled worker is configured, so webhook deliveries wait until an operator runs the worker.

plans.read: Read published plans and service types

plan.unpublished: A published plan went back to draft or was archived

credentialState.issuer_inactive: Inactive — issuer is no longer an administrator

webhookError.timeout: The endpoint did not answer in time
webhookError.destination_blocked: The address resolves to a private or reserved network
webhookError.dns_failed: The host name could not be resolved
webhookError.connection_failed: Could not connect to the endpoint
webhookError.redirect_not_followed: The endpoint redirected; update the URL instead
webhookError.secret_unavailable: The signing secret could not be read on the server

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Automatic reminders for unanswered requests and upcoming confirmed services. A team setting overrides its service type, which overrides the church; without any, Service Center sends one reminder 3 days before an unanswered request and one 1 day before a confirmed person is needed. Reminders stop on their own when someone answers, is removed, or the time changes.

kindDescription.pending_response: Sent before the first applicable service time to people who have not answered.
kindDescription.confirmed_service: Sent before the first time a confirmed person needs to be there (rehearsals included).

reminders.maxPerDay_one: at most {{count}} a day per channel
reminders.maxPerDay_other: at most {{count}} a day per channel
reminders.invalidQuiet: Quiet hours must start and end at different times.
reminders.savedRecomputed: Saved. Upcoming reminders will be recomputed.
reminders.readOnly: You can see this setting but not change it.

myReminders.title: My reminders
myReminders.description: Choose how automatic reminders reach you. New requests and changes are still sent.
myReminders.none: You will not receive automatic reminders.

help.title: Help with my schedule
help.description: Let someone you trust answer requests or update your availability for you. They see only what you allow — never plan notes or files — and you can stop it at any time.
help.allowView: See my requests (dates, times and roles)
help.allowAvailability: Manage my blockout dates and preferences

preferences.inheritsHint: Uses your all-teams preferences until you save something specific to this team.
preferences.warningHint: Schedulers see these as warnings. Use blockout dates for times you truly can’t serve.
preferences.entryDescription: How often and which weeks you'd like to serve on each team.
preferences.noTeams: You're not on any team in this church yet. Preferences appear here once a leader adds you to a team.
preferences.noPerson: Your login isn't linked to a person in this church yet, so there are no team preferences to set.
preferences.preferredTimesHint: Local start times like 09:00, 11:00. Leave empty for any time.
preferences.maxPerMonthHint: A whole number from 1 to 31. Leave empty for no limit. Several positions on one service count once.
preferences.invalidMax: Enter a whole number from 1 to 31, or leave it empty.
preferences.invalidTimes: Use 24-hour times like 09:00, separated by commas.
preferences.stale: These preferences changed somewhere else. Your edits are still here — reload to see the latest, then save again.
preferences.warningVsUnavailable: Preferences are warnings for schedulers; you can still be scheduled. Blockout dates on your profile are when you truly can't serve.
preferences.datesOnWebsite: Specific preferred or avoided dates are kept and can be changed on the website.

serviceTypeFiles.title: Service type default files
serviceTypeFiles.description: New plans of the service type get these files automatically, pinned to the version current at that moment. Changing a default later does not change plans that already exist.

profile.photoPermissionMessage: Allow photo access to choose a logo.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: A light page for planning at a desk, a dark one for a dim stage.

organizations.title: Churches
organizations.description: Start another church or ministry whenever you need one — you stay signed in to both.
